reviewer: Claude 2, independent; did not author the subject
discipline: Refute, do not confirm. v10 is a remasurement successor, not a repair successor: v9 was dual ACCEPT 0/0 and lands no charge onto v10, so the entire warrant of this subject is that D-245 moved the world and v10 restates the leftover posture accurately against the moved world. That shape dictated the attack. The danger in a repair successor is that the repair is cosmetic; the danger in a remasurement successor is the opposite — that the operative fields are correctly advanced to the new input while some field that merely DESCRIBES those fields is carried forward verbatim from the predecessor and silently goes stale. So the review was run as three attacks. First, custody and arithmetic were re-derived from primary sources rather than inherited from v9's ACCEPT: every digest anywhere in the document was recomputed from disk, the obligation partition was recomputed as a set equality, the remainder was recomputed as named-minus-authored, and the two CC-5 payloads were read as bytes and unpacked as big-endian unsigned integers rather than trusted as described. Second, the occupancy v4 passProperty was read in full and set against the subject's rendition, because truncating that clause by dropping its D-002 platform limb was the evidentiary core of G21LJ-V6-SF1 and a successor is where it would silently reappear. Third, and decisively, v9 and v10 were flattened to leaf paths and diffed key-by-key, and every field that was NOT changed was then re-checked against v10's own changed fields rather than against v9's world. That third attack is what found the finding: v10 advances its executionRemains recitation from corpus v1 to corpus v7 in four operative places and leaves the fifth — the disposition note whose whole job is to say where that recitation lives — reciting corpus v1.
decisionRule: ACCEPT only at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Zero MUST-FIX stand, but one SHOULD-FIX stands, so the verdict is REJECT.

The two live fields were recomputed from disk and differ exactly as charged: corpus v1 authoredCatalog.executionRemains ends '...subsequent-session view, and host-projection goldens remain G21 execution (D-056), not leftover-design'; corpus v7 authoredCatalog.executionRemains ends '...host-projection goldens, and EV-5 diagnostic/audit bytes remain G21 execution (D-056), not leftover-design'. Exactly one, this note, carries the corpus v1 three-item form. So v10 states in one field that its reason recites a content that four other fields of v10 show it does not recite.

This is a stale carry-forward in a remasurement successor, which is the characteristic failure mode of this document shape: the operative fields were advanced to the new input and the field that merely describes them was not.

decision: REJECT — 0 MUST-FIX, 1 SHOULD-FIX (G21LJ-V10-SF1). The subject holds its pinned path, SHA-256 4b6ca553… and mode 0444 on D-245 HEAD, and its measurement of the world is accurate throughout. All 56 recorded inputs and all 50 inline digest pairs reproduce from disk and agree with each other; all four cited commits resolve to the recordings attributed to them; the seven-obligation partition is exact with every leftoverDesign flag matching its bucket; the named corpus is byte-identical to live G21 v3; the remainder recomputes as named-minus-authored and correctly narrows the whole class CC-5 to 'remaining CC-5 injections' with all ten enumerated entries quoted verbatim from corpus v7's own whatIsNotAuthored; the two CC-5 payloads exist on disk at the recorded digests and unpack to the stated N=0 and N=65537; and the occupancy v4 passProperty is rendered without the D-002 platform truncation that sank v6. Live standing is measured and not touched: DR-G21 OPEN and PROPOSED; not QUALIFIED, required-now 28, DR-102 SATISFIED unreopened, DR-114 and DR-133 OPEN, the DR-114 remainder left resting on doctor-actor leftover-join.v11, and no platform token anywhere in the file. Frozen v7, v8, v9 and corpus v7 are unmoved. What fails is narrower and is the characteristic defect of a remasurement successor rather than a repair one. v10 advanced its recitation of authoredCatalog.executionRemains from corpus v1 to corpus v7 — adding the fourth item, EV-5 diagnostic/audit bytes — in four operative fields, and left the fifth unchanged from v9: appliesFindingsOf.v6[0].landed still asserts in the present tense that the OBL-G21-FX-AUTHORING reason recites corpus v1 and the three-item list. That is false of v10's own bytes on both counts and puts the artifact in contradiction with itself, in the very ledger entry whose purpose is to let a reader confirm G21LJ-V6-SF1 is still landed — and G21LJ-V6-SF1 was itself a finding about faithful recitation of that field. The underlying finding is landed in substance; only its account is stale, so the charge is SHOULD-FIX and not MUST-FIX. The remedy is local, needs no new fact, and has a precedent in this lineage: historically scope the sentence and supersede it in the same breath, as v9 did one field above to land G21LJ-V8-SF1.
